title: Opentrons COVID-19 Testing Protocol for 48 Samples
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bestjeen

steps.title: Set up OT-2 Deck Labware
steps.instruction: Place the required labware into the specified slots on the OT-2 deck.

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Opentrons Temperature Module with an Opentrons 96 well aluminum block and an empty, sterile NEST 100 µL PCR plate
Slot 3, 6, 7, 9, and 10: Full, sterile racks of Opentrons 200 µL filter tips
Slot 11: Empty NEST 1-well reservoir for organic liquid waste

steps.title: Pre-cool Temperature Module
steps.instruction: Start pre-cooling the Temperature Module to 6 °C and wait for it to reach the target temperature.

steps.title: Load Sample and Reagent Labware
steps.instruction: Place the sample well plate in slot 4 and the reagent reservoir in slot 2.

steps.title: Verify Deck Layout
steps.instruction: Double-check that all labware are inserted correctly (well A1 at top-left for plates, well 1 at the left for troughs) and properly clicked into the deck slots.

steps.title: Prepare Viral DNA/RNA Buffer and Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare three separate 14.35 mL aliquots of Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads in sterile 15 mL tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 14 mL Viral DNA/RNA Buffer to a sterile 15 mL tube
Vortex the MagBinding Beads in their container
Pipe 0.35 mL of vortexed MagBinding Beads into the 15 mL tube
Repeat this process to create a total of 3x 14.35 mL aliquots

steps.title: Fill Reagent Reservoir
steps.instruction: Quickly fill a 15 mL NEST 12 well reservoir with the following reagents, vortexing the Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads immediately before adding.

substeps.instruction: Well 1: 14.35 mL, Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads
Well 2: 14.35 mL, Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads
Well 3: 14.35 mL, Viral DNA/RNA Buffer + MagBinding Beads

steps.title: Prepare Sample Well Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a NEST 96 deep well plate containing 48 samples (#1–#48) as follows for each sample well:

steps.title: Execute OT-2 Protocol
steps.instruction: Run the Station B protocol (file: StationB-48samples-Zymo.py) on the OT-2.

steps.title: Complete Run
steps.instruction: Wait for the run to finish, which should take approximately 2.5–3 hours. The output is the NEST 100 µL PCR plate in slot 1.
